title: Supabase MCP: connect Supabase to an AI agent | ottermind

facts.fact: Supabase MCP is described on the page as Supabase's official Model Context Protocol server for its Postgres-backed platform.
facts.quote: Supabase MCP is Supabase's official Model Context Protocol server for its Postgres-backed platform.

facts.fact: Ottermind states it treats Supabase MCP as a managed connector, with no local process and no config file to maintain.
facts.quote: Ottermind treats it as a managed connector — no local process, no config file to maintain.

facts.fact: To connect Supabase, the user finds Supabase in Ottermind's connectors and authorizes it, and Ottermind hosts the connection.
facts.quote: Find Supabase and authorize it. Ottermind hosts the connection.

facts.fact: Ottermind's Supabase connector access starts read-only where the provider supports it.
facts.quote: Access starts read-only where the provider supports it, write operations ask for confirmation before running, and you can revoke the connection at any time.

facts.fact: Ottermind states that write operations through the Supabase connection ask for confirmation before running.
facts.quote: Access starts read-only where the provider supports it, write operations ask for confirmation before running, and you can revoke the connection at any time.

facts.fact: Ottermind states that the user can revoke the Supabase connection at any time.
facts.quote: Access starts read-only where the provider supports it, write operations ask for confirmation before running, and you can revoke the connection at any time.

facts.fact: Ottermind says a local Supabase MCP server is only needed if the agent must reach something on the user's own machine, a case the desktop app supports.
facts.quote: A local server is only needed if you want the agent to reach something on your own machine, which the desktop app supports.

facts.fact: Ottermind states it runs on Claude models and speaks MCP.
facts.quote: Ottermind runs on Claude models and speaks MCP

facts.fact: With Supabase MCP, the agent can list tables, columns, types and foreign keys before writing a query.
facts.quote: List tables, columns, types and foreign keys, so a generated query references real objects.

facts.fact: With Supabase MCP, the agent can run SQL against the project and return results as data that can be turned into a table or chart.
facts.quote: Run SQL against the project and get results back as data you can turn into a table or a chart.

facts.fact: Supabase MCP lets the agent draft schema changes and regenerate typed clients from the current schema.
facts.quote: Draft schema changes and regenerate typed clients from the current schema.

facts.fact: Supabase MCP gives the agent access to project logs and project configuration.
facts.quote: Reach logs and project configuration, which is what makes debugging possible in the same conversation.
